display.purpose: The one large uppercase statement per screen.

soft.purpose: Archivo italic beside or above the display line.

label.purpose: Row keys, tabs, buttons and captions; never under 11px.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Speech bubbles, toasts and dialogs floating over the board.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: A drawing resting on the plate.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Every reveal, underline draw and geometry change.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Looping cues such as the engine beat.

motion.name: grain
motion.purpose: Film grain over the whole page.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action that moves the work forward.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; height:56px; padding:0 30px; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:#ede6dc; color:#0b0a09; font:600 12px Geist, Helvetica, sans-serif; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .3s; } .ds-btn svg { width:16px; height:16px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.6; transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background:#fff; } .ds-btn:hover svg { transform:translateX(4px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:1px solid #ede6dc; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Line Button
components.css: .ds-line { height:40px; padding:0 20px; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:#ede6dc; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(237,230,220,.2); font:600 11px Geist, Helvetica, sans-serif; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; } .ds-line:hover { box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(237,230,220,.5); } .ds-line:focus-visible { outline:1px solid #ede6dc; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Toggle
components.description: A room or option that is in or out.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-block; padding:8px 15px; border-radius:999px; font:400 13px Geist, Helvetica, sans-serif; color:rgba(237,230,220,.74); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(237,230,220,.2); } .ds-chip:hover { color:#ede6dc; } .ds-chip.is-on { background:#ede6dc; color:#0b0a09; box-shadow:none; }

components.name: Underline Number
components.description: A quantity in the specification sheet.
components.css: .ds-num { display:inline-flex; align-items:baseline; gap:8px; } .ds-num input { width:4.6ch; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(237,230,220,.2); background:transparent; color:#ede6dc; font:400 24px Geist, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-num input:focus { outline:none; border-color:#ede6dc; } .ds-num i { font:400 13px Geist, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-style:normal; color:rgba(237,230,220,.5); }

components.name: View Tab
components.description: Header and pane tabs: selected by an underline drawn from the left.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display:flex; gap:2px; } .ds-tabs button { position:relative; height:36px; padding:0 12px; border:0; background:none; color:rgba(237,230,220,.5); font:600 11.5px Geist, Helvetica, sans-serif; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; } .ds-tabs button::after { content:''; position:absolute; left:12px; right:12px; bottom:4px; height:1px; background:#ede6dc; transform:scaleX(0); transform-origin:left; transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-tabs button:hover, .ds-tabs .is-on { color:#ede6dc; } .ds-tabs .is-on::after { transform:scaleX(1); }

components.name: Chapter Caption
components.description: The run's stage: an informative index over one large uppercase word.
components.css: .ds-ch p { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; margin:0 0 14px; font:600 11px Geist, Helvetica, sans-serif; letter-spacing:.16em; text-transform:uppercase; color:rgba(237,230,220,.74); } .ds-ch p::after { content:''; width:56px; height:1px; background:rgba(237,230,220,.5); } .ds-ch h3 { margin:0; font:500 72px/.92 Archivo, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-stretch:94%; letter-spacing:-.025em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#ede6dc; } .ds-ch span { display:block; margin-top:14px; font:400 15px Geist, Helvetica, sans-serif; color:rgba(237,230,220,.74); }

narrative.overview: The studio runs in the Studio Rabbit world: warm black, cream type, film grain, nothing that glows. What matters is set large, uppercase and tight in Archivo with an italic soft line; everything you operate is quiet Geist. Structure comes from hairline rules, not boxes, and the only colour that speaks is brick red, for failure.
keyCharacteristics: Warm black ground and cream type
Archivo uppercase display with an italic soft line
Brick red as the only signal

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Brick red appears only where something fails.

rules.name: The Chapter Rule
rules.body: A screen's subject is said once, large and uppercase; an index line sits above it only when the index carries information.

dos: Do set each screen's subject large, uppercase and once.
Do separate with hairlines and space before containers.
Do keep numbers tabular and labels at 11px or larger.
Do keep red for failure only.
donts: Don't add cards, glass, glow, gradient text or coloured borders thicker than 1px.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't use emoji or glyphs as icons.
Don't bring back the navy, gold-on-black or starfield looks.
